verdict.rationale: Airwallex is an API-first financial platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question. The evidence covers llms.txt, markdown docs pages, typed server-side SDKs, a CLI and an MCP-based AgentOS. None of it mentions a downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger or other machine-readable API specification, and llms.txt and markdown docs are documentation indexes rather than API specs.
